preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.intro: Language, formats and units apply to you only. torq stores values in metric units and converts them for display.
preferences.currencySymbolHint: Optional, up to 5 characters. Overrides the symbol shown for the currency.
preferences.unitsHint: How distances, fluids, torque, pressure, displacement and power are shown and entered.

distance_unit.label: Distance
distance_unit.hint: Used for new vehicles. Each vehicle has its own odometer unit.

preferences.priorityDisplayHint: With color only, the name appears when you point at it.
preferences.cardTagLimitHint: More tags are shown as “+ n more”.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Everyone shares one garage. Each user's role decides what they may change and which vehicles they see; administrators also manage users, roles, webhooks and instance settings.
users.resetPasswordIntro: Set a new password for {{name}}. All of their sessions will be signed out.
users.deleteBody: Delete {{name}}? Records they created stay in the garage.
users.accessIntro: View: sees the vehicle and everything about it. Edit: may also make the changes the role allows.
users.allVehiclesNote: The role {{role}} sees all vehicles, so these assignments have no effect until the role is limited to assigned vehicles.
users.mfaResetBody: Remove the authenticator app, passkeys and recovery codes of {{name}} and sign them out everywhere? They then sign in with their password (and set up a new method if one is required).

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: Everywhere your account is signed in: browsers and the torq app. Sign out a device you no longer use or have lost.
devices.revokeBody: Sign out {{name}}? It will need to sign in again.
devices.revokeCurrentBody: This is the device you are using. You will be signed out.
devices.revokeOthersBody: Every device except this one will be signed out.
devices.none: No other devices are signed in.
devices.demo: The device list is not available in the demo, because every visitor shares the demo account.

instance.title: Instance
instance.intro: Settings that apply to the whole torq instance.
instance.monthlyDayHint: 1–28, so every month has the day.
instance.baseUrlSet: Configured — notifications link back to torq
instance.baseUrlUnset: Not set — notifications contain no links
instance.defaultsIntro: New accounts start with these formats and units. Existing users keep theirs.

branding.title: Name and logo
branding.intro: Shown in the header, on the sign-in page, in the browser title and on the printed vehicle history. Exports and notifications include the name.
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or SVG, at most {{max_kb}} KB. It replaces the torq logo; anyone who can reach this server sees it on the sign-in page.
branding.name: Name
branding.nameHint: Shown next to the logo. Leave it empty if your logo already contains the name. Anyone who can reach this server sees it on the sign-in page.
branding.contactHint: Printed at the top of the vehicle history. Only signed-in users see them.

publicLinks.title: Public links
publicLinks.intro: Members can share a read-only page of a vehicle with people who have no account, e.g. a workshop or a buyer. The links are listed here.
publicLinks.offNotice: All public links are turned off and answer “not found”. Turning this back on makes the existing links work again.
publicLinks.empty: No vehicle has a public link.
publicLinks.offBody: The link stops working at once. Turning it on again creates a new address.

about.title: About torq
about.intro: Version and the open vehicle data torq uses.
about.offline: Vehicle lookups (HSN/TSN quick-fill and make/model suggestions) always run offline against the catalog stored in torq. No API keys, no external services.
about.modified: torq modified this data (normalized names, merged sources). See NOTICE.md in the repository for details.
about.counts: {{kba}} HSN/TSN entries and {{vehicles}} make/model/engine entries, {{motorcycles}} of them for motorcycles.
about.derived: The combined catalog database is distributed under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0.
about.empty: No vehicle catalog is loaded. Vehicles can still be entered manually.
about.updateHint: Downloads the current KBA FZ 6 list, the vehicle-makes-models data and the RDW motorcycle data, rebuilds the catalog and replaces it in one step. This takes a few minutes; lookups keep working meanwhile.
about.updateDisabled: Online updates are turned off on this server (TORQ_CATALOG_ONLINE_UPDATES=false).

updateStates.unchanged: Sources unchanged since the last update ({{time}}).
updateStates.failed: Update failed {{time}}; the previous catalog is still in use.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: A role decides what its users may change and which vehicles they see. Viewing is always allowed for the vehicles a user sees.
roles.name: Name
roles.allVehiclesHint: Users with this role see every vehicle in the garage.
roles.assignedVehiclesHint: Users with this role see only the vehicles assigned to them under Users; vehicles they add are assigned to them.
roles.losingVehicles_one: {{count}} user has this role and will see only the vehicles assigned to them.
roles.losingVehicles_other: {{count}} users have this role and will see only the vehicles assigned to them.
roles.adminOnly: Users, roles, vehicle access, webhooks and instance settings are always reserved to administrators.
roles.deleteMove_one: {{count}} user has this role. Choose the role they move to.
roles.deleteMove_other: {{count}} users have this role. Choose the role they move to.

scopeHint.vehicle: On vehicles the user may edit.
scopeHint.garage: Settings shared by the whole garage.
scopeHint.view: What users see on every vehicle visible to them.

permission.vehicles.edit: Edit vehicles (profile, readings, hour meters, photo, archive)
permission.vehicle_access.share: Share own vehicles with other users
permission.reports.view: See reports and the vehicle history

roles.requireMfaHint: Users with this role must set up an authenticator app or a passkey after their next sign-in before they can do anything else.
roles.requireMfaSelf: This is your role and you have no second factor yet: right after saving you can only set one up.
roles.adminRole: The Administrator role always may do everything. Here you can only require two-factor sign-in for it.

permissionHint.vehicle_access.share: Users can give other users View or Edit on vehicles they may edit themselves, by username. They can’t pass on vehicles shared with them.

security.title: Sign-in & security
security.intro: Your password, two-factor sign-in and passkeys.
security.setupRequired: Your account requires two-factor sign-in. Set up an authenticator app or a passkey to continue.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.intro: After your password, torq asks for a 6-digit code from an app such as Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator or your password manager.
totp.step1: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or type the setup key.
totp.step2: Enter the code the app shows.
totp.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.turnOffBody: Sign-in then no longer asks for a code from the app.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password. A passkey also works as the second step after your password.
passkeys.addIntro: Give the passkey a name so you recognize it later, e.g. the device it's on. Your browser then asks you to confirm.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.unavailable: Passkeys aren't available on this server: an administrator has to set the server address (TORQ_BASE_URL).
passkeys.removeBody: Remove {{name}}? It can't be used to sign in any more. Also delete it on the device.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.intro: If you lose your phone, sign in with a recovery code instead. Each code works once.
recovery.low: You are running out of recovery codes. Generate new ones.
recovery.renewBody: Your current recovery codes stop working.
recovery.newIntro: Store them somewhere safe, e.g. printed or in your password manager. They are shown only now.
